note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The datum is only the lane a step is supplied for; both lanes, trolleys and connectors are drawn alike. No share, percentage, fault, contributory-negligence doctrine, liability, amount or outcome is stated.
